title: Mickey and Minnie go on a picnic.
lines: Mickey Mouse lives in a cheerful little house with a red roof.
He wears red shorts and yellow shoes.
Minnie has a pink bow with white dots.
Mickey also calls his other friends.
Donald Duck, Goofy and Pluto, his dog.
They walk to the hill together.
They spread a red checked blanket on the grass.
They put the basket in the middle.
But then they hear a sound.
The little bee flies around the lemonade.
Goofy tries to catch the little bee with his hat.
Minnie says: You shouldn't make a bee angry.
Stay calm, and she'll go away by herself.
The little bee flies to a flower.
Then they hear barking behind a bush.
Pluto has found a little hedgehog.
Pluto gently pushes the little hedgehog to its mum with his nose.
The friends tidy everything up nicely.
They don't leave any rubbish behind.
What a fun day, says Minnie.
